scenarios.name: Bounded edits, retained facts and date validation
observed: All three approved title/review-intent alternatives were exercised across the run; required forecast/quote/abstention/programme warnings remained.
Unchecked confirmation produced a localized linked error. Today and day 365 were accepted; yesterday and day 366 were rejected with focus on review-dueDate and aria-describedby.
Clearing the due date by keyboard activation persisted a receipt with no due date. Dates for boundary tests were supplied through the documented reviewDue route selector.
scenarios.supplementalNonBrowserEvidence: HTTP supplement rejected invalid Gregorian date, unlisted/empty/overlength/markup/control title and rationale, and missing confirmation. Leap-day/local-midnight cases are deterministic-test evidence, not physical browser date entry.
remaining: Native date typing/picker behavior remains part of blocked QA-15.

observed: Explicit browser confirmation produced localized durable receipts for all three authorized actors.
Receipt refresh, locale switch, navigation history and project Actions reopening retained action identity and evidence references.

scenarios.name: Locale, draft routes, refresh and history
observed: Stable proposal routes preserved choices across locale and evidence navigation.
Fast title edit immediately after the sheet appeared rewrote the old comparison URL without proposal. Refresh then lost the review sheet/draft.
An immediate locale switch was also observed to return to comparison without the proposal sheet.
scenarios.supplementalNonBrowserEvidence: See finding F-02; source was not changed.

scenarios.name: Retry, replay and idempotency conflict
observed: Two tabs loaded the same proposal before submission. First confirmation created action_a58c6e51-fcf3-463c-93e3-e186cebffe51; second displayed the same saved action with replay wording.
Replay wording localized to Chinese; no extra action was created.
scenarios.supplementalNonBrowserEvidence: Actual HTTP identical and locale-switched retries returned IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY; changed payload returned IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; a new key returned PROPOSAL_ALREADY_CONSUMED. Concurrent/after-expiry/source-change replay additionally passed in PostgreSQL tests.

scenarios.name: Viewer and unauthenticated denial
observed: Viewer had no creation control or financial amounts and could not reopen copied proposal/receipt selectors in either locale.
After final session revocation the browser displayed only the controlled-demo-session-required state.
scenarios.supplementalNonBrowserEvidence: HTTP unauthenticated and revoked requests denied with private/no-store. Deterministic tests checked denial before sensitive reads.
remaining: Expired-session browser variant was not executed; do not infer it from HTTP or deterministic tests. Remaining variations stopped after F-01.

scenarios.name: Cross-tenant selectors
observed: Northern admin could not open Horizon project/comparison or copied receipt; both locales showed neutral unavailable states without Horizon details.
scenarios.supplementalNonBrowserEvidence: HTTP Northern proposal/confirmation/receipt and nonexistent-receipt pairs were neutral; foreign assignee rejected. PostgreSQL suite separately covers project/run/enrichment/proposal/receipt selectors.
remaining: Full paired browser matrix for nonexistent project/run/enrichment/evidence selectors was not executed. Remaining variants stopped after F-01.

remaining: Explicit no-assign alternate-payload and each evidence-ineligible/unassigned-person browser variant were not independently repeated. Remaining variants stopped after F-01.

scenarios.name: Expiry and consumed proposals
observed: Existing service clock injection prepared an immutable proposal 29 minutes in the past without changing production clock or bypassing DB guards. Browser opened it while valid.
After real expiry, confirmation returned PROPOSAL_EXPIRED and localized safe expiry messages in both locales; action counts remained four.
An attempted direct expiry edit was rejected by the immutability trigger and left unchanged.
scenarios.supplementalNonBrowserEvidence: Exact-at-expiry boundary is deterministic service-clock test evidence. Consumed/new-key rejection and identical-key replay were exercised through actual HTTP; millisecond equality is not claimed as a browser timing measurement.

scenarios.name: Service failure and transaction rollback
observed: A temporary local receipt-insert fault produced a safe Chinese failure while preserving the draft.
Database proved no partial action/receipt/audit/consumption. Removing the fault and retrying created exactly one durable action.
scenarios.supplementalNonBrowserEvidence: Passing PostgreSQL tests injected failure at every declared transaction checkpoint. Browser fault was at receipt insertion; no debug mutation endpoint or source patch was added.

observed: Enter/Space/Escape/Tab/Shift+Tab exercised dialog controls, confirmation, evidence navigation and cancellation.
Observed focus containment, linked date/confirmation/assignee errors, locked-default error fallback and receipt-heading focus.
scenarios.supplementalNonBrowserEvidence: These observations do not establish a fully keyboard-only journey or screen-reader certification.
remaining: 200% zoom shortcut attempts did not change measured viewport; no verified zoom run.
Reduced-motion override not exposed by this browser backend.
Native date fill/keypress did not reliably change React state in this automation backend; no claim that physical keyboard date entry passed.
Screen-reader announcements and real-device touch/keyboard behavior were not tested.

findings.title: Active forecast costs are labeled as reconciled actual costs
findings.observed: The Xinyi active-project column places forecast NT$12,650,000 total and NT$2,360,000 imported stone under actual-cost headings; evidence correctly identifies forecast direct cost. This misstates authority at the point of comparison.
reproduction: Issue a trusted synthetic Mei session; open an existing authorized Xinyi comparison with the canonical three selected historical projects. No new proposal/action is needed.

At 1440x900 in en, scroll to Overall commercial comparison and Category comparison. Inspect the active Xinyi column: forecast NT$12,650,000 appears under Reconciled actual cost · normalized, and forecast NT$2,360,000 under Imported stone · actual.
Switch to zh-TW and observe the equivalent 已核對實際成本 · 標準化 and 進口石材 · 實際成本 labels.
Open the Xinyi NT$3,688/m² imported-stone evidence cell, scroll to the Xinyi source card, and observe 預估直接成本 with the same NT$2,360,000 amount.
findings.disposition: Acceptance blocked. Stop further business-write QA; return to Builder. No source fix made.
findings.expectedBehavior: Distinguish the active quotation forecast direct costs from historical reconciled actual costs at the visible table cells and in evidence; do not imply active forecast amounts have actual-cost authority.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Prior deterministic comparison/evidence behavior remains intact, including distinct economics labels.
Active Xinyi forecast total and category values are visibly identified as forecasts in English and Taiwan Traditional Chinese; historical actual values retain their actual labels.
Displayed amounts, normalized values, variances and linked source authority agree. Capture corrected desktop/mobile table and evidence views on the new exact build.

findings.title: Immediate draft edit can discard the proposal route
findings.observed: The sheet is interactive before router navigation has settled. updateDraft uses the old window URL, so a fast selection can replace history without proposal; refresh loses the sheet. Immediate locale switch also dropped the sheet.
reproduction: Create a fresh comparison and open review.
Immediately change title before proposal navigation settles.
Observe reviewTitle in URL with no proposal selector. Refresh.
findings.disposition: Reproducible route/draft UX defect; no write or authorization bypass observed.
findings.additionalObservedLocaleTransition: en to zh-TW was observed during the original run but has no dedicated before/after screenshot pair.
findings.expectedBehavior: Once the review sheet accepts interaction, its proposal identity and bounded draft choices remain in the route across immediate edits, locale changes, evidence navigation, refresh and history.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Locale/route/refresh/history preserve proposal identity and allowed draft fields without a write or fabricated receipt.
Immediately change each supported draft field after the sheet appears, then refresh: proposal remains in URL and correct draft is restored.
Immediately switch en/zh-TW after preparation or edit: same proposal and allowed draft survive; no duplicate proposal/action is created.

findings.captureLimit: The before state is a DOM/URL capture, not a screenshot. The after screenshot shows comparison with no review sheet. No rerun or success is invented.
findings.rootCauseAssessment: Likely mechanism from source review: setPrepared exposes the sheet before router.push settles, while updateDraft reads window.location and calls replaceState. This mechanism is an inference; the lost-route observation is direct.
findings.blockingDisposition: Unresolved failed scenario in the acceptance gate; severity remains P2. F-01 is the P1 stop condition. No Stage 8 acceptance is claimed.
